item.description:
Pomace 1.1.3

Pomace fixes a 1.1.2 regression that made Compress look dead on very large folders.

  • Compressing a folder whose scan was capped at 200,000 displayed rows now shows a visible "Preparing the full file list…" indicator while the complete target list is gathered, instead of appearing to do nothing.
  • Compress and Decompress are disabled while that list is prepared, in both the window and the menu bar, so a second press can no longer be swallowed silently.
  • Switching folders while the list is prepared now explains itself instead of silently dropping the run.

Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later.

Pomace 1.1.2

Pomace adds per-folder insight: savings estimates, exclusions, and re-expansion reporting.

  • Each watched folder now shows an estimate of the space compression would reclaim, sampled from real temporary copies so the estimate reflects your files and your chosen compressor.
  • Folders can exclude files and subfolders by name pattern; excluded paths are skipped by scans and sweeps and labeled in the file table.
  • A degradation indicator shows how much a folder has drifted since its last compression, so you can see when a re-compression is worthwhile.
  • A re-expansion report attributes space reclaimed by decompression to your manual and scheduled actions.
  • Scan history is pruned at launch and per folder, keeping the most recent runs for watched folders and dropping records for folders you no longer watch.
  • Fixed scan cancellation, truncated runs, sweep scheduling and accounting bugs; improved schedule drift tolerance, error reporting, and accessibility labels for the exclusion field and existing controls.

Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later.

Pomace 1.1.1

Pomace gains a refreshed native interface with adaptive Carolina blue and navy styling.

  • Light and dark appearances use clearer panels, typography, and compression metrics.
  • The scan summary fits the available window space without scrolling. Metrics reflow into compact rows when the schedule inspector is open or the window is narrow.
  • Compression coverage, reclaimed space, and Compress / Decompress controls remain visible after a scan.
  • Existing automatic updates, the bundled compressor, localized controls, keyboard navigation, and safety confirmations are preserved.

Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later.

Pomace 1.1.0

This is the last update you need to install by hand: Pomace now updates itself.

  • Install Pomace by opening the disk image and dragging Pomace to Applications.
  • Pomace includes its compression tool, so Homebrew is no longer required.
  • The app and bundled compressor support Apple silicon and Intel Macs running macOS 14 or later.
  • Automatic update checks and Check for Updates are available in Pomace.
  • A custom compressor can still be selected in Advanced settings and is checked before each run.
